recipes.name: Super Seed Stuffed Dates
instructions: Using a sharp paring knife, make an incision along the length of each date, but try not to cut the date in half. Remove the pits from the dates.
In a small bowl, combine the peanut butter, pumpkin, sunflower, chia, sesame, and hemp seeds.
Dollop the peanut butter mixture into the dates.
If desired, drizzle the filled dates with melted chocolate and extra hemp seeds. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store these dates at room temperature an airtight container for up to 4 days, or in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.
